final: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.InvoiceDate BETWEEN '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_invoice_amount, AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM state_totals
